description: A farm manager must track animal treatments and product withdrawal periods so milk, eggs, or meat remain compliant while several animals are on different treatment timelines.

user_profile.persona: 43-year-old livestock manager responsible for both animal care and product handling
user_profile.context: The treatments are manageable individually, but hard to hold together accurately once several animals overlap
user_profile.communication_style: Compliance-minded and exact, wants timelines and restrictions tied to each animal or group

fact_sheet.fact: Elias Vance is the Livestock Manager at Oakhaven Pastures, responsible for all animal treatment records.
The consulting veterinarian for Oakhaven Pastures is Dr. Aris Thorne, reachable at 555-010-8821.
All regulated veterinary medicines are stored in Medication Locker M2 in the main barn, which is kept at 15°C.
Animals undergoing treatment with active withdrawal periods are housed in Quarantine Pen #3.
All treatment and withdrawal data is logged in the cloud-based software 'AgriTrack Pro'.
The login URL for Oakhaven Pastures' AgriTrack Pro instance is https://oakhaven.agritrack.pro.
Elias Vance's username for AgriTrack Pro is 'evance43'.
Holstein cow with ear tag 'OH-305' was born on April 12, 2020.
Jersey cow with ear tag 'OH-218' is currently lactating and produces an average of 22 liters of milk per day.
The laying hens in Coop B2 are a flock of 250 Rhode Island Reds.
A Duroc boar, identified by ear notch '14-2', is housed in the breeding pen.
Cow OH-305 began a 5-day course of 'Mastiguard Forte' on October 15, 2023, for clinical mastitis.
The prescribed dosage for Mastiguard Forte for cow OH-305 is 30 mL administered intramuscularly every 24 hours.
The entire flock in Coop B2 was treated for coccidiosis with 'Coccid-X' via their water supply from October 10 to October 14, 2023.
Cow OH-218 received a single subcutaneous injection of 10 mL of 'RespiraClear' on October 18, 2023, for a respiratory infection.
The final dose of Mastiguard Forte for cow OH-305 was administered at 08:00 on October 19, 2023.
The milk withdrawal period for Mastiguard Forte is 72 hours after the final dose.
The meat withdrawal period for Mastiguard Forte is 21 days after the final dose.
The egg withdrawal period for Coccid-X is 10 days from the last day of treatment.
The meat withdrawal period for RespiraClear is 28 days after injection.
The milk withdrawal period for RespiraClear is 96 hours after injection.
Milk from cow OH-305 must be discarded until after 08:00 on October 22, 2023.
Eggs from Coop B2 cannot be sold for human consumption until October 25, 2023.
Milk from cow OH-218 is under a withdrawal hold until 11:00 on October 22, 2023.
Oakhaven Pastures is subject to a mandatory annual audit by the 'Valley Dairy Cooperative' for antibiotic residue testing.
The next scheduled Valley Dairy Cooperative audit is on December 5, 2023.
A red tag is physically placed on the stall for any animal with an active milk withdrawal period.
In AgriTrack Pro, the 'Daily Withdrawal Report' (Report ID #DWR-001) must be printed and posted in the milking parlor each morning.
Lot numbers for all administered medications must be entered into the 'Treatment Log' page in AgriTrack Pro.
The lot number for the Mastiguard Forte used on cow OH-305 is MG-F-883401B.
The lot number for the RespiraClear used on cow OH-218 is RC-229155C.
Cow OH-305 is currently housed in Quarantine Pen #3 due to her active treatment.
The farm's standard operating procedure requires a 'Clear-to-Ship' form to be signed by Elias Vance before any animal is sold for meat.
AgriTrack Pro sends an automated SMS alert to Elias Vance's phone (555-010-1234) 12 hours before a withdrawal period ends.
Dr. Thorne must approve any off-label use of medication in writing before administration, per farm policy #FP-VET-002.
